title: Unity Web3 Demo
tagline: Build the next generation of video games with wallet-less experiences
description: A combination of technologies including Privy and Base used to leverage a new level of onchain experiences within the gaming industry. Gone are the days of needing a browser wallet to interact onchain within video games. All you need is a social login. NFTs also enable the use of maintaining your assets across the entire web, including inside and outside video games.
how_its_made:
I used Base as the blockchain for high speed and cheap transactions.

Privy for allowing user's to maintain, manage, and utilize  a wallet address using only social logins within both the website and video game experiences.

Unity for building the video game while integrating the Privy Unity SDK.

Forked Scaffold-ETH 2 to create a companion website that let me jumpstart and prototype with incredible speed for deploying smart contracts and interacting with them through a web interface while also hosting a build of the video game.
